notes: Posted 31 July 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Chasm, Uh-oh! and The Camp; these count toward the total.

The list totals 64 as posted (Starting 8, Characters 23, Effects 6, Interrupts 22, four locations under a 'Locations (5)' header, and Anakin's Podracer under 'Other'); kept as published. With the starting Han the list has three copies of the unique Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, as posted.

Posted 'Profit/or be destroyed' dested the Light objective You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed; 'Tatooine jabba's palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Jabbas palace Audience chamber' and 'Jabba's Palace Entrance Cavern' dested the Light Jabba's Palace sites.

Posted 'Threepio WPS' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Wioslea (the wo-man)' dested Wioslea; 'Wind Chimes' dested Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes (the poster writes combos with '+'); 'Out Of Commission + TT' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Tatooine Jungleand Wastes' dested the Light Official Tournament Sealed Deck site Tatooine: Jundland Wastes; 'Obi w/ Stick' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Leia w/ Gun' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle.
Yarna d'al' Gargan and Mantellian Savrip are Light Effects, posted under Effects. The 'Other' header line was not a card.
